annotations.title: Flat prices in a Polish municipality (gmina) from notarial deeds

description: Use for flat prices per m2 in a municipality (gmina), especially a small town or a rural or suburban municipality such as Piaseczno or Kobierzyce, and for how many flats were sold there. For the ranking of cities, use get_city_flat_prices; for districts of a large city, use get_housing_prices. Flat transaction prices per m² from notarial deeds (RCN) in one Polish municipality (gmina), also rural and urban-rural ones: number of deeds, median and quartiles of the price per m² in the last 4 full quarters of the county (from 30 deeds; fewer = small sample, count only), primary and secondary market, year-over-year change, deeds per 1000 residents and the last 8 quarters. Warsaw districts and city delegations are merged into the city. With a name matching several municipalities: the list with TERYT codes to choose from. Aggregates only, no individual deeds.

municipality.description: Municipality name, e.g. "Piaseczno", or its 7-digit TERYT code, e.g. "1418073".

voivodeship.description: Optional voivodeship to narrow a name, e.g. "mazowieckie" or "14".
